attacker_monitors_mempool.meaning: attacker monitors the public mempool for liquidity-addition transactions

price_validation_present.meaning: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange validates price against TWAP or historical baselines

deadline_is_block_timestamp.meaning: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange uses block.timestamp as the deadline so execution has no delay mechanism

liquidity_value_received.meaning: liquidity value the protocol receives for the assets it provided in the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange call

liquidity_value_should_have.meaning: liquidity value the protocol should have received corresponding to the assets it provided, absent surrounding pool-price manipulation

assumptions: The protocol provides assets to increaseLiquidityCurrentRange and the call executes.
The attacker can manipulate pool price immediately before and after the liquidity addition.
liquidity_value_received and liquidity_value_should_have are comparable in the same liquidity-value unit.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition or baseline for the fair liquidity value the protocol should have received; the reference quantity is symbolic.
Report does not state concrete pool prices or amounts used in the sandwich, only that manipulation occurs around the addition.

limitations: Formalizes only the i_less_liquidity_value impact; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
The fair-rate reference quantity is symbolic because the report supplies no numeric baseline.
Attacker authorization status is not established; only mempool monitoring is stated.
